verdict.rationale: Spline documents its own pen tool that 'works in a familiar way to other 2D or UI design tools'. Its Hana 2D canvas is described as being for interfaces, with vector networks. Its boolean operations are documented only for 3D objects, not 2D vector paths. Missing for 10: path/node editing detail, 2D vector boolean operations, precise alignment/distribution tools, independent hands-on corroboration of professional-grade interface vector work.

support.subject: As a designer, I get professional vector tools — pen and path editing, boolean operations, precise alignment — for real interface design work

citations.quote: The pen tool enables you to create custom 2D shapes in the 3D space. It works in a familiar way to other 2D or UI design tools.
A 2D canvas for interfaces and animated graphics — vector networks, effects, typography
There are 3 different Boolean Operations that you can apply to a set of selected 3D objects: Union ... Subtract ... Intersect
